summary: A 1933 steel tower in Savanna State Forest, restored in 1992 and open to climbing visitors; staffing, early use and fires are not documented in the sources read.

facts.design: Steel tower, 94 ft, with a 7x7 ft cab, made by the Pittsburg-Des Moines Company

access.note: The McGregor chamber describes visitors climbing to the top. No hours, fees or rules were found in the pages read.

notes_for_editor: Staffing, early use, fires and current hours are not in any source read, so none are given. The record's agency (Minnesota Dept. of Natural Resources) is not confirmed by the pages read: they name the Minnesota Division of Forestry as builder in 1933 and place the tower in Savanna State Forest, but none states the current manager, so facts.agency keeps the builder. Wikidata (Q107541658) lists 1933 and Aitkin County; its linked blog returns HTTP 404 and was not used. Access rests on one chamber page; confirm hours with the managing agency.
